human_quote: Je valide FI01–FI06, IF01–IF14 et tes clarifications. Enregistre mes décisions, puis prépare les schémas machine et les exemples d’entrée/sortie avant l’implémentation. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.
approval_basis: One actual collective message approving six FI decisions, fourteen IF requirements and six preceding clarifications; not 26 separate approval exchanges.

approved_interface_decisions.FI01: Separate ledger/wrapper from unchanged core schemas and preserve the original core result.
approved_interface_decisions.FI02: Preserve verbatim text, hashes, original origins and explicit slot states.
approved_interface_decisions.FI03: Dispatch representable units through one common core call; preblock scoped unrepresentable ambiguity or policy conflicts.
approved_interface_decisions.FI04: Account for every recognizable unit, including omitted and failed units, without coverage by subtraction.
approved_interface_decisions.FI05: Declare the EN/FR language perimeter and scoped unsupported-construction diagnostics.
approved_interface_decisions.FI06: Require IF01-IF14 conformance before candidate freeze; machine examples need separate review.

approved_clarifications.IC01: Separate interpretation fidelity, documentary support and full-request service status.
approved_clarifications.IC02: Preblocked means not assessed by planner, not absent from the manual; source exclusions remain visible.
approved_clarifications.IC03: Use a null core result with an explicit reason when no planner was called; never fabricate an empty computed plan.
approved_clarifications.IC04: Preserve independent items only when a restriction is clearly local; block every possibly affected scope otherwise.
approved_clarifications.IC05: Review exact machine limits, supported constructions, diagnostics and complete representative fixtures before coding.
approved_clarifications.IC06: Keep G05 semantic-only until equivalent unresolved ownership can be expressed faithfully in both comparison arms.

not_approved_or_performed: New machine field choices, caps, example wording and exact origin annotations remain pending review.
No interpreter implementation, candidate freeze, planner/retrieval/model call or prospective comparison.
No new source approval, unit conversion, runtime/schema/catalog modification, commit or push.
